evidence: Updates block and undo data writing logic in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush buffers and trigger a graceful fatal shutdown on write failure.
rationale: Prevents abrupt `std::terminate` crashes during block and undo disk writes when the disk fills up. Explicitly catching and logging buffered write errors in `blockstorage.cpp` ensures clean shutdown sequencing and diagnostic logs rather than an unhandled termination.
